description: Agent Governance: submit a test or sandbox environment design for agents: the credentials it holds (where each is accepted and how it is made), the systems, tool platforms and endpoints the agents use (production, shared or sandbox, whether the sandbox can connect, internet exposure, what each accepts to let a caller in, the access it grants and its rate limit), the data it holds or can read, and its outbound default. The signed report names every path from the test environment into production systems or data, production asset by production asset: credentials accepted in production, predictable, default or shared credentials, production or shared systems that take a sandbox credential or none, production data the sandbox can read, unrestricted outbound reach and reachable systems with no rate limit, with the fix for each. A single route from the sandbox to a production effect is wever_escape-path-check and check order inside one payment flow is wever_firewall-order-check. Verdict production_reachable, isolation_unverified or isolated. POST /api/sandbox-isolation-check. Reads only the material in the call: no network request, fetch, money movement, message, sharing, configuration change or external write. Paid URL: 0.10 USDC per call on Base via x402 exact, with the shared 10 signed-wallet free calls per rolling 30 days. Bind X-Wever-Wallet-Proof to the exact JSON arguments and the tool route. Returns a report with an Ed25519 signed receipt. Contract: /api/agent-governance-contract. Human page: https://weverlabs.com/agent-governance/.

accepts.description: What it accepts to let a caller in.

access.description: What a caller can do once in.

internet_reachable.description: It answers on the public internet.

reachable.description: The sandbox can connect to it.
